warning: This is the original PlantNet-300K 1081-class model. It is NOT the trained 10-class VIT specialist. Unity should use this temporarily to unblock UI/pipeline integration.

preprocessing.notes: Crop from detector bbox, resize to 256, center crop to 224 (or directly resize to 224x224), convert to float32 [0-1] range, then normalize with above mean/std.

output.name: logits_1081
output.notes: Outputs raw logits. Apply Softmax in C# to get probabilities.
